title: Red Hat Security Advisory: libxml2 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified and fixed in the libxml2 library used in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 Extended Update Support. These include denial of service, arbitrary code execution via various buffer overflow and use-after-free flaws, data integrity issues due to integer overflow, information disclosure, SSRF, and double-free/use-after-free in Python bindings. The update synchronizes release versions across several RHEL releases and addresses these critical security issues.
